name: shop-siren~p2
task: Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) hard matches 'each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off'. siren_ringing is false on the toggle step, so each ring's obligation closes there, and the rule-only warning is valid because the task is conditional.

texts: Each time the siren starts ringing, the agent must toggle the siren switch on that step or later, so every ring is turned off.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u1
(u1, switch_toggled) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled, u1) -> -1
(u1, switch_toggled, u0) -> 1
